teacher_info.teaching_style:
All classes are customized to student needs. However, the basic structure is as follows:

For writing classes, we will spend the time editing a writing sample you provide (prompts and questions can be given). We will review grammar, spelling, cohesion, vocabulary and structure.

For pronunciation, we cover four key concepts needed for a natural accent in American English: placement, pitch, breath, and weak consonants. We take a pronunciation test to find the specific areas of strength and focus before moving to sentence-level structures (intonation, linking, stress, reductions). Our long-term goal: to listen to native speakers, identify what techniques they use, and copy them ourselves.

In this course, we will focus on two essential concepts: 1) organization and 2) delivery. Organizing will help you develop your plan of action, what to say, how to respond, and what materials you will need. The second focus of delivery covers simply the best way to effectively leave a positive impression on an audience or interviewer and to develop people skills and confidence. The combination of these will carry you to success. Included are mock interviews, practicing presentations, and debates.
